parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in human assays against human amine oxidase B (flavin-containing). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter assays by organism Homo sapiens and target_dictionary by the exact target name. Return one row per compound with columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
